decision: Keep nanosecond snapshot mtime preservation; reject/revert resumption-wording candidate. No demonstrated model-task speedup.
implementation: Standard PAX decimal timestamps preserve nanosecond file/subdirectory mtimes. Root, access/creation times, ownership and xattrs not promised. Reject malformed/nonfinite/out-of-signed64ns timestamps transactionally. Check identity remains bytes plus executable mode.
findings: Timestamp loss reproduced and fixed mechanically. Ordinary unchanged file/subdirectory mtimes survive actual isolated calls; malformed metadata rejects both snapshot generations atomically. Content/mode identities ignore timestamps, including same-size content changes with restored timestamps.
